page_title: LEN 4-0 MON | Lens v Monaco 17/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90' The substitution is prepared. Malang Sarr (Lens) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Facundo Medina.
88' Will Still decides to make a substitution. Neil El Aynaoui will be replaced by Wesley Said (Lens).
84' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the right-hand post. Philipp Kohn is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
83' Today's match ends for Eliesse Ben Seghir who will be replaced by Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco).
83' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Takumi Minamino (Monaco) as he is replaced by Denis Zakaria.
83' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
80' Will Still prepares a substitution. Ruben Aguilar is replaced by Tom Pouilly (Lens).
80' It is time for a substitution. Florian Sotoca is on for Andy Diouf (Lens).
80' We are about to witness a subsitution. Martin Satriano for Goduine Koyalipou (Lens).
78' 4 - 0 Andy Diouf feeds the ball through to Anass Zaroury (Lens), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the top right corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 4:0!

77' Saimon Bouabre (Monaco) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
74' Here is a change. George Ilenikhena (Monaco) is going off and Adi Hutter gives the last tactical orders to Lucas Michal.
73' 3 - 0 Adrien Thomasson (Lens) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
72' Lens can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
72' Facundo Medina (Lens) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Lens are awarded a corner kick.
71' A pass by Ruben Aguilar (Lens) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
70' Facundo Medina (Lens) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.
67' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
67' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Lens have been awarded a corner kick.
66' Adi Hutter has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Saimon Bouabre (Monaco) replacing Krepin Diatta.
63' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
61' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
56' 2 - 0 Goal! Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot into the top right corner. It's 2:0.
56' Nampalys Mendy (Lens) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
54' The VAR review is over and the red card for Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) stands! Off he trudges.

53' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco), but referee Francois Letexier must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
52' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) makes an ugly challenge on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
51' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
46' Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post.
46' Substitution. Jordan Teze makes his way off the pitch and Vanderson (Monaco) comes on as his replacement.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Lens take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
45+1' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) receives a yellow card from the referee, but it seems like a very harsh decision.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Philipp Kohn leaps to intercept the corner kick from Neil El Aynaoui (Lens).
43' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Facundo Medina (Lens).
40' Monaco take a short corner kick.

39' Mathew Ryan pulls off a great save to deny Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner. The linesman makes the right call and Monaco will have a corner.
36' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) commits a rough challenge and Francois Letexier blows his whistle for an infringement.
33' Monaco have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

32' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot to the right side of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Mathew Ryan shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop his effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity! Good work from Monaco as they win a corner.
30' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Lens due to a foul in the build-up play.
30' Wait! Referee Francois Letexier has indicated he is going to review the Lens goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
29' Goal! Goduine Koyalipou (Lens) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Andy Diouf inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the bottom left corner. 2:0.
24' Lamine Camara (Monaco) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

21' 1 - 0 Goal – 1:0! Nampalys Mendy sends a precise lofted pass into the box, Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) rises above the defenders to meet the ball near the penalty spot and heads it straight into the left side of the goal.
20' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
18' A long ball forward to Adrien Thomasson (Lens) is intercepted.
17' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
15' The resulting set piece from Monaco is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
15' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Caio Henrique (Monaco) is thwarted and cleared to safety. Monaco win a corner.
12' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance.
11' Andy Diouf (Lens) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
8' Neil El Aynaoui (Lens) was too forceful with his tackle and Francois Letexier interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
4' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
1' The first half has started.
Monaco will kick the game off.
Francois Letexier will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
